text: **Hint 1:** In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. For each value of the hyperparameter, a model is trained $$8$$ times, each time using a different part of the data as the validation set and the remaining parts as the training set.\n\n**Hint 2:** Since there are $$11$$ different values of the hyperparameter to test, and each requires $$8$$ models to be fit (one for each fold), you need to calculate the total number of models by multiplying the number of folds by the number of hyperparameter values.
